days_meaning: each delivery day adds this much cash to your side

messages.text: Hi there. 43 P from my side. Delivery on day 10.
Happy to deliver the Fiesta de San Cayetano at 82 primas with 10 delivery days, a fair price we can close on right away.
How about 90 P? Delivery on day 0.
Close to a deal: 91 P with delivery on day 4 works for us.
I can move to 100 P. Delivery on day 0.
